title: Moving a swallowed bolus
hook: Locate one step on the digestive map.

knows: Digestion involves several organs and routes.
doesNotKnow: The esophagus moves the swallowed bolus toward the stomach using coordinated muscular contractions called peristalsis.

misconception: All digestive processes happen in a single organ.
objective: Locate the stated digestive process or absorption route.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Which tube uses peristaltic contractions to move a swallowed bolus toward the stomach? The esophagus moves the swallowed bolus toward the stomach using coordinated muscular contractions called peristalsis.
The map shows selected connections schematically; it is not an anatomical scale drawing or a complete account of digestion.
